response.description:
In late-February 2026,
the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  
 Introducing Search Database Objects in the MSSQL
     extension for Visual Studio Code. Instantly find tables, views,
     functions, and procedures with full scripting options across your SQL
     database. 
 Import your settings and
     keyboard shortcuts from Azure Data Studio to the MSSQL
     Extension. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for late-February 2026
